title: The Fidelity Frontier in Computational Psychiatry: Decomposing Acquisition and Encoding Loss in Psychopathology
domain: computational psychiatry / phenomenological psychopathology / neurophenomenology / psychometrics / mental-health measurement
summary: A measurement framework that separates psychiatric acquisition from encoding loss. Pilot-0 now runs on real open schizophrenia interview material (DAIS-C) with privacy-preserving source inventory, structural segmentation, blinded boundary calibration, and later same-source representation fidelity benchmarking.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided research design and Pilot-0 engineering; formal manuscript provenance to be frozen at full run
